configuration.executionOrder: For each N, rotate canonical [conventional, occupancy, bitmask, symmetry] left by (repetition - 1 + N - starting N) modulo 4. Sequential execution. Ten repetitions contain two full cycles plus two additional positions, not complete counterbalancing.
configuration.warmup: One full untimed-for-comparison solve per measured trial, same fresh Node worker; warm-up metrics retained separately in raw CSV.
configuration.source: Dedicated Node.js research experiment; no browser-generated timings included
configuration.memory: Unavailable: no reliable isolated per-algorithm peak measurement

processor.physicalCoreCountNote: Win32_Processor query was denied; physical core count is not inferred from logical processors.

conditions.execution: One sequential worker at a time, terminated before the next trial. One full warm-up then one measured solve in the same fresh worker.
conditions.timing: Unmodified solver performance.now() elapsed interval; excludes worker startup, module loading, warm-up, source stripping, result serialization, file I/O, visualization and rendering.
conditions.solutionEnumeration: All solutions, including mirror weights for symmetry; no early first-solution exit.
conditions.gcPolicy: Default V8 automatic garbage collection; no per-algorithm GC intervention.
conditions.affinity: Not pinned; OS chooses logical processor. Priority and power settings are observed, not changed.
conditions.backgroundLoad: Shared interactive workstation; other applications were not closed or controlled. No concurrent agent-run tests/builds or browser benchmarks during collection.
conditions.processorFrequency: Dynamic; os.cpus().speed is an observed value, not a guaranteed fixed clock.
conditions.warmupLimit: One full warm-up may not stabilize JIT behavior, especially at small N. This design matches the application trial-worker protocol.
conditions.externalWatchdog: Each phase has a 120-second watchdog plus 3-second scheduling allowance; worker startup separately limited to 30 seconds. Solver checks deadlines every 1024 nodes.
conditions.memory: Unavailable: no reliable isolated per-algorithm peak/allocation measurement is applied. System RAM metadata is not algorithm memory usage.

source.transformation: Node built-in stripTypeScriptTypes(mode=strip); type erasure only. Application experiment scheduling and aggregation imported with its types-module URL resolved in memory.

correctnessReference.accessNote: OEIS indexed table retrieved via web search; direct b-file endpoint returned HTTP 403.

endConditions.note: Aggregate machine CPU activity includes other applications; it is not per-algorithm utilization or memory.

outputPolicy: Raw CSV contains a separate warmup and measured row for every planned trial. Only complete verified measured groups enter statistics. Partial elapsed/counters from timed-out executions are diagnostic only.

statistics.median: Middle pair average for 10 sorted elapsed times
